verdict.rationale: Temporal offers building blocks that can be used to collapse noisy events by hand. Schedules start Workflow Executions at specific times, and long-running stateful Workflows receive Signals and Updates through message handlers, so a developer could code debounce or batch logic inside a Workflow. Nothing in the evidence documents built-in debounce, batching, or delayed-trigger features, so this is a roll-your-own pattern rather than a shipped capability. Missing for 10: native debounce/coalescing of triggers, built-in event batching windows, documented delayed or deferred workflow start, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the pattern.
